about: The red cells a monster's cast will hit (ZC_SKILL_SCALE). A test NPC (skill-area.txt) makes a Poring 4 cells east of the player cast NPC_WIDESILENCE level 1 on itself with a 6 s longer cast; rathena flags that skill ShowScale, so the server also sends the cast's area, 5x5 (SkillScale) around the Poring. The client draws each of those cells as a soft red tile, pulsing (brightest 2.4 s in, where the shot is), for the cast time, then drops them.
